summary: RUS203 added the last test, PR #97. It restarts the app while one agent is in the middle of a software-factory build and another is mid-turn on its own task. After the reopen, each one finishes exactly once and both reports reach me. The test fails if the double-run guard is removed, so the restart work and the factory work fit together correctly.
